component: NNTP filter phase and action validation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For NewsRule without PostPlugin, the action menu hides Copy Message to and disables its selected target. The separate row validator rejects the unsupported move/copy branch, and the save caller stops on false. This prevents saving that unsupported phase even when a prior action already exists; it is not a prohibition on every NNTP copy phase. The callback also records unsupported actions as failures, latches applyMore false and flushes list logs after application. That flag does not itself break the current action loop or catch all exceptions. No NNTP, UI or test run was performed.
title: News filters enforce the before-classification copy restriction at menu and save time
